authority.purpose: Local JSONL diagnostics for Mac, Android, toweb, and relay; correlating disconnect timelines without entering the business channel
authority.row_fields: ts, side, event, corr?, link_id?, device_id?, request_id?, detail?
authority.web_storage: browser localStorage keys web-YYYYMMDD; in-memory ring for recent UI
authority.web_client_detail: detail.client is browser or webview (UA contains TocodeToweb/); detail.browser is Edge/Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Browser

invariants: Diagnostics are an ops side-channel only; they must not change reconnect, mac_offline, or online business semantics.
Rows never contain token, device_token, link_token, authorization, binding_key, binding_key_digest, chat text/content/body, path plaintext, attachment bytes, password, or secret.
Cross-client correlation uses link_id, request_id, corr, and UTC ts; relay may still label web sockets as side_peer=android.
Diagnostics are not uploaded through the relay; export is manual (copy/download/zip/Finder).
toweb (side=web) emits the same event names as Android for ws.*, state.online, state.mac_offline, drop_waits, app.*, command.*, and pair.* where applicable.
prohibited_results: Writing secrets or message bodies into JSONL.
Uploading diagnostic aggregates through the relay without a separate approved work package.
Changing reconnect backoff or mac_offline determination via the diagnostics path.
Using diagnostics to persist command/result bodies in routes.json.
